_provenance.description: Verbatim transcription of the FREE (non-subscriber) portion of RotoGrinders' public MLB projection grid. Everything below the sixth row is behind the MLB Premium paywall, so these six rows are the complete set of RotoGrinders projection data that can be observed without a subscription - and therefore the only ground truth available for calibrating and validating an open rebuild.
_provenance.source_title: MLB DFS Projections, pOWN%, & Stat Projections
_provenance.retrieval_method: HTTP GET of the public grid page, HTML table transcribed cell by cell. No value has been rounded, inferred, interpolated or corrected: the transcription preserves RotoGrinders' own floating-point artefacts (for example OBFPTS 15.172400000000001) precisely because 'we copied the number that was on the page' must remain checkable against the page.
page_states_observed: "To access this content, subscribe to MLB Premium or purchase a 3-day trial."
Slate filter chips present for 1B, 2B, C, SS, 3B, OF (no pitcher chip in the free view)

slate_context.note: All six free rows are Arizona hitters facing Colorado at Coors Field. The free tier exposes exactly one team of one game, so no pitcher row and no second team could be observed.

_provenance.licence_note: Reproduced here in full as a small factual dataset for the purpose of validating an independent projection system, with the source URL and retrieval date recorded so every number can be re-checked by hand. No RotoGrinders code, markup, branding or paywalled content is reproduced.

column_count_note: The header renders 49 logical columns, matching rgengy.models.RG_GRID_COLUMNS['mlb'] exactly. One column is renamed in this fixture: the grid's 'FPTS/$' is stored as 'FPTS_PER_SALARY' because '/' is awkward as a JSON key. scripts/analyze_rg_public_grid.py maps it back, and test_rg_grid.py asserts the rest of the schema is identical to the code constant. Two header cells also carry an 'All...' filter affordance in the rendered page ("TEAM AllARI", "OPP AllCOL"); the logical column names are plain TEAM and OPP. See IR-20.

rows._anomaly: FLOOR is exactly 0 while CEIL is 23.53 and FPTS is 9.89. Every other free row has FLOOR between 0.269 and 0.334 of FPTS. Recorded verbatim and flagged as IR-19; the row is EXCLUDED from the fitted floor ratio rather than silently imputed.

derived_observations._note: Recomputed from `rows` by scripts/analyze_rg_public_grid.py. These are OBSERVATIONS on n=6, not fitted parameters: six points from one team in one game cannot identify a distribution. They are used only to sanity-check RGENGY's own floor/ceiling scale, and the small sample is the reason rgengy/engines.py defaults to deriving bands from its own outcome distribution rather than from these ratios.

fpts_per_salary_identity.verdict: CONFIRMED EXACTLY on all six rows (residual is display rounding only)

obfpts_ratio.verdict: OBFPTS is consistently 8.5-12.6% above FPTS and is published at full float precision while FPTS is rounded to 2dp. Its definition is not published anywhere reachable; see IR-21.

constant_across_all_rows.verdict: These are slate-level or team-level, not player-level. TEAMOWN being identical for all six rows is consistent with it meaning 'projected ownership of this team's stack'. The player-level ownership column is POWN, which does vary (10.07%-23.36%).

derived_observations.pown_note: POWN across the six free rows sums to 100.68%, i.e. essentially the whole field, which is consistent with these six being the only Arizona hitters RotoGrinders projects for this slate. It also means POWN is expressed as a share of projected field usage, not as an independent probability. See IR-22.

prizepicks_equals_fpts.verdict: PRIZEPICKS == FPTS exactly on all six rows (13.48, 12.09, 11.16, 10.8, 10.67, 9.89), while UNDERDOG is a distinct, higher number on every row (14.37, 13.08, 12.07, 11.5, 11.42, 10.51). Two of RG's three prop-partner columns therefore carry RG's own DFS projection verbatim, and only UNDERDOG carries something different. Flagged as IR-23 because publishing a DFS projection under a prop-partner brand implies an equivalence that is not documented.
